description:
T1 - mimosa tree (12m) - reduce crown to previous pruning points, approximately 1.5m reduction and lift crown by approximately 2m.

T2 - pittosporum tree (7m) - lift crown by approximately 1m and reduce crown by approximately 1m.

T3 - magnolia tree (4m) - reduce height by approximately 2m.

T4 - viburnum tree (5m) - reduce crown by approximately 1m.

T5 - holly tree (3m) - reduce crown by approximately 0.5m into spherical shape.

T6 - laurel tree (5m) - reduce crown by approximately 1m.

Front garden-

T7 - willow-leaved pear tree (6m) - reduce crown into dome shape by approximately 1m.

T8 - mahonia tree (3m) - reduce height by approximately 0.5m to separate from pear.

T9 - holly tree (3m) - take down to ground level.

T10 - olive tree (2m) - reduce crown by approximately 0.3m.

T11 - olive tree (2m) - reduce crown by approximately 0.3m.

T12 - olive tree (2m) - reduce crown by approximately 0.3m.
